verdict.rationale: Canny ships a first-party changelog product, marketed as 'Product Changelog Software and Release Notes Tool', for announcing shipped work and showing customers their feedback was heard. That matches the story's publish-and-close-the-loop goal. The evidence is marketing-level only, so the publishing workflow and how customers are notified are not detailed. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on publishing and authoring changelog entries, documented customer notification of linked feedback, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can publish a changelog announcing shipped features to close the loop with customers

citations.quote: Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
Product Changelog Software and Release Notes Tool
